title: Providers Tab
description: Providers Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers providers tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the Providers list
subtasks.purpose: See every provider (physician / NP) attached to the practice.

steps.title: Search or Filter Providers
steps.description: Use the Search providers… box or All Status filter to narrow the list.

steps.title: Sort Providers List
steps.description: Click column headers to sort ascending / descending.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Delete Provider
steps.description: Use the view / edit / delete icons per row. Notes Providers are the billing / signing clinicians; they must exist before patients can be assigned to them under Patients.

subtasks.title: Add a Provider
subtasks.purpose: Register a new provider under the practice.

steps.title: Enter Provider Details
steps.description: Enter Name, credentials, NPI, Address, Home Phone, Cell Phone, Fax, Email and Username.

steps.title: Save Provider
steps.description: Click Save. Notes Provider email drives system notifications (missed uploads, follow-ups) and must be unique. Task 7.5 — Caregivers Tab
